rules: All calculator and explanation content is publicly available without an account.

routes.name: Recipe Scaler
routes.purpose: Edit ingredients and serving counts, view original or scaled quantities, receive validation feedback, and reset the example.

routes.name: How it works
routes.purpose: Explain the scaling calculation and provide navigation back to the calculator.

states.empty: When every ingredient has been removed, the calculator visibly shows "Add an ingredient to start scaling."
states.error: There is no remote save error because recipe edits are transient.
states.loading: The built-in example is visible immediately without remote loading.
states.success: For valid serving values, the selected list visibly shows each original or scaled ingredient quantity.
states.validation: A blank, zero, or negative original or desired serving count visibly shows "Enter a serving count greater than zero" inline and "Scaled quantities unavailable" in the scaled area.

states.empty: Not applicable because explanatory content is fixed.
states.error: Not applicable because the page has no remote dependency.
states.loading: The static explanation is visible immediately.
states.success: The formula explanation and calculator navigation are visible.
states.validation: Not applicable because the page has no input controls.

summary: A responsive, warm editorial recipe scaling calculator lets visitors edit a four-serving recipe, scale ingredient quantities, validate serving counts, reset the example, and read a short explanation without accounts or external services.

deferred.item: User accounts and saved recipe history
deferred.reason: The request requires no login and does not request persistence or recovery.
The request explicitly requires no payments.

deferred.item: External recipe, nutrition, or unit-conversion APIs
deferred.reason: The request explicitly requires no external API.

entities.name: recipe
relationships: one recipe has many ingredient rows

entities.name: ingredient
relationships: each ingredient row belongs to one recipe

steps.expect: the scaling formula explanation is visible
visibleText: scaled quantity = original quantity × desired servings ÷ original servings

steps.expect: the calculator controls are visible again

journeys.title: A visitor reads the scaling explanation and returns to the calculator
acceptance: The How it works page visibly explains the scaling formula.
The How it works page provides visible navigation back to Recipe scaler.

acceptance.statement: With original servings 4 and desired servings 6, the scaled ingredient list visibly contains rice 450 g, water 900 ml, and salt 3 tsp.
A zero, negative, or blank serving count visibly shows inline feedback and "Scaled quantities unavailable".
A visitor can visibly add pepper 1.5 tbsp, view pepper 2.25 tbsp at six servings, and remove pepper.
Reset visibly restores the original four-serving list containing rice 300 g, water 600 ml, and salt 2 tsp.
The How it works page visibly presents the scaling formula and a route back to the calculator.

operations.description: Validate that both serving counts are present and greater than zero.

responsibilities.behavior: Set hasValidScale to true only when originalServings and desiredServings are both numbers greater than zero; otherwise set it to false.

operations.description: Calculate each visible ingredient quantity using the selected serving ratio.

responsibilities.behavior: For each non-removed ingredient when serving counts are valid, set scaledQuantity to originalQuantity multiplied by desiredServings divided by originalServings, retaining decimal precision without forced integer rounding.

operations.description: Add a blank editable transient ingredient row to the recipe.

responsibilities.behavior: Create one visible ingredient row associated with the current recipe and initialized for visitor entry.

operations.description: Apply editable name, quantity, and unit values to an ingredient row.

responsibilities.behavior: Update the selected transient ingredient row with the entered name, decimal-capable original quantity, and unit.

operations.description: Hide a selected ingredient from both original and scaled lists.

responsibilities.behavior: Mark the selected transient ingredient as removed so it is not displayed or included in scaling.

operations.description: Restore the calculator serving values and original-list view.

responsibilities.behavior: Restore originalServings and desiredServings to 4, select the original list, set validation to valid, and increment resetVersion.

operations.description: Restore the built-in rice, water, and salt ingredient rows.

responsibilities.behavior: Restore the visible ingredient rows to rice 300 g, water 600 ml, and salt 2 tsp, restore their scaled quantities for four servings, and remove transient added-row changes from the displayed list.
